route_contract.compared: HTTP method + full URI + resolved controller action + middleware stack, for all 385 routes, against docs/audit/routes-baseline.json

api_behaviour.detail: No route, controller, action, middleware entry, request class, resource or response payload was added, removed or edited. All 16 deletions were classes that no request path could reach.

schema.method: Laravel information_schema query (mysqldump is unavailable in this environment)

architecture_test.note: The architecture rules and their debt allowlists are unchanged, so deleting 16 conformant files did not disturb Rule 2 (no Domain->Services/Http/Models), Rule 11 (no Http in Domain) or Rule 12 (no Services locator in Http).

items.test: Tests\Feature\BookingConcurrencyTest > second booking rejected after first consumes last unit
items.cause: Message-wording drift only. The test asserts the substring 'no longer available'; the booking path now returns a clearer EligibilityResult message. The locking behaviour the test was written to protect is separately covered by a passing test that asserts a second booking is rejected.

items.test: Tests\Feature\CampaignBookingPricingIntegrityTest > booking rejects quantity over fleet availability
items.cause: Same class of drift: an expected message no longer matches.
Tautological assertion in a pure static helper test; reported as a warning, not a failure.

known_failures.decision: Not fixed. Changing an assertion string during a retirement phase would mask a real behaviour question and is out of scope. Recorded as controlled debt.

financial_behaviour.detail: No pricing, availability, booking, payment, refund, settlement or commission path was touched. The only financial-adjacent deletion was App\Enums\PaymentStatus, which was unreferenced; the live vocabulary App\Domain\Payment\PaymentStatus is intact.
financial_behaviour.evidence: The campaign pricing integrity tests, minute pricing tests and payment tests all run within the 571 passing set and are unchanged in count.

concurrency.detail: InventoryService::checkAvailabilityForUpdate and the booking use-case transaction boundaries were not modified.

scheduler_queue_events.detail: The 4 scheduler entries, 133 Artisan commands, 34 event classes and container bindings were untouched. Notably, the 3 scheduled commands initially flagged as dead were retained and confirmed live.

external_integrations.detail: The infrastructure adapters (Razorpay, OAuth/Google, ExchangeRates, Media, Notification) were not modified in Phase 0.17.
